authority_boundary: Read-only regression critique. This ledger does not bind an Alumnos root, choose a human-facing page, promote a candidate, mutate Current/Catalog/Lineage/Human Accepted/Served, or change shared Study/PageKit product ownership.

truth_ceiling.surface_identity: alumnos-teacher is currently a coordination surface identifier, not proof of one physical teacher/student page.
truth_ceiling.root_binding: project-alumnos remains canonically unbound in PROJECT_INDEX. A prior discovery produced alumnos-root-v1 / chat-object-alumnos-main as a binding candidate, but the candidate is not canonical authority yet.
truth_ceiling.active_child_frontier: jose-study-design-20260911 V11 is the strongest durable LAB restart frontier for José Study; it is not Current, Human Accepted or Served.
truth_ceiling.student_world_runtime: shared/student-world/runtime/v2 is TESTED_CANDIDATE mechanism evidence, not promoted runtime authority.
truth_ceiling.pagekit: V26 is a stable rollback donor; V37 is a selective capability candidate. Version number does not promote whole-product authority.
truth_ceiling.shared_study_owner: shared/study/current.json defines prometeo-study-ui v1 / 1.0.0 as the shared Study UI owner. Breaking changes require v2 plus explicit consumer migration.

protected_invariants.name: IDENTITIES_STAY_DISTINCT
protected_invariants.rule: Do not flatten the Alumnos coordination root, Student World, José Study, subject, class, atlas, homework, Chemistry and PageKit/Class Player into one generic page identity.
protected_invariants.why: The recovered lineage explicitly assigns different roles and owners; collapsing them creates false authority and destroys reopenability.

protected_invariants.name: ROOT_BINDING_IS_EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY
protected_invariants.rule: Presence of live/recovered child pages must never be interpreted as a canonical Alumnos root binding. Root materialization/binding must happen through the declared project/root authority path.
protected_invariants.why: PROJECT_INDEX still has null primary_chat_object_id and primary_workstream_id for project-alumnos while a concrete root candidate exists separately.

protected_invariants.name: SHARED_STUDY_HAS_ONE_OWNER
protected_invariants.rule: Student-specific/root work may consume Study UI but must not fork its CSS/JS or invent a second shared Study owner. Compatible v1 fixes stay in v1; breaking behavior requires v2 and explicit consumer migration.
protected_invariants.why: A local fork would make later fixes divergent and violate the one-owner-per-global-capability law.

protected_invariants.name: JOSE_V11_STRUCTURE_SURVIVES
protected_invariants.rule: When continuing José Study, preserve four distinct Algebra topics, each with its own 12-level map, and preserve the 48 canonical exercises sourced from pages/JOSE_RECUPERACION_ALGEBRA_FINAL.html unless an explicit scoped change replaces them.
protected_invariants.why: This is the durable V11 frontier; flattening topics or silently replacing exercise identity would be a capability/content regression.

protected_invariants.name: THEORY_AND_PRACTICE_NOT_DESTRUCTIVELY_COUPLED
protected_invariants.rule: Theory and practice may synchronize by concept but scrolling theory must not silently change/destroy practice state, exercise state or answer state.
protected_invariants.why: V11 explicitly rejects destructive coupling; swarm-generated UI composition must preserve local study continuity.

protected_invariants.name: MOBILE_AND_POINTER_PARITY
protected_invariants.rule: Preserve real constrained nested scrolling and the proven input routes relevant to V11: touch/pen drag, mouse grab-drag, wheel/trackpad, while canvas drag remains drawing. Do not make normal four-option MCQ comparison require avoidable scrolling on a small phone.
protected_invariants.why: Gesture code without correct overflow geometry previously produced false interaction support; dense answer layouts are known negative knowledge.

protected_invariants.name: PAGEKIT_ADOPTION_IS_CAPABILITY_SELECTIVE
protected_invariants.rule: Use V26 as rollback/stability donor and adopt V37 gains selectively when explicitly wanted; do not promote the whole V37 UX because one capability is better.
protected_invariants.why: Laser/object tracking, multi-board objects and typed undo are candidate gains, while the whole V37 UX has no Human Accepted scope.

protected_invariants.name: ANNOTATION_SEMANTICS_SURVIVE
protected_invariants.rule: Never reintroduce hover erasure. If erase/object operations are adopted from V37, preserve typed reversible undo rather than collapsing back to last-stroke pop. Keep V37 board-session tabs distinct from Psico sheet tabs.
protected_invariants.why: These semantics are independently recovered and are not interchangeable merely because they share whiteboard UI vocabulary.

protected_invariants.name: UNPROVED_INPUT_FEATURES_STAY_UNPROVED
protected_invariants.rule: Do not claim Wacom pressure/buttons or application Fullscreen support from generic Pointer Events, UI copy, responsive viewport behavior or iframe allowFullscreen.
protected_invariants.why: Recovered static evidence does not prove those capabilities.

protected_invariants.name: PAGE_CHANGE_LOOP_RETURNS_TO_HOST
protected_invariants.rule: When Alumnos becomes page-editable, a human correction must flow through Page Change Thread -> execution -> durable RETURN -> Page Change Feed -> host-routed preview/result. The primary result route must not eject the human to an orphan raw child URL.
protected_invariants.why: The canonical human development surface preserves Universal Control, page-local intent and durable reincarnation across disposable workers.

protected_invariants.name: SWARM_EDITING_NEVER_BYPASSES_CONCURRENCY_AND_AUTHORITY
protected_invariants.rule: Every material mutation must resolve current owner/EPOCH, re-fetch exact target, detect overlapping active writers and avoid stale overwrite; no candidate result may self-promote to Current/Human Accepted/Served.
protected_invariants.why: A swarm increases stale-write and authority-inflation risk unless isolated claims and prewrite reconciliation remain part of the edit path.

protected_invariants.name: HUMAN_IS_NOT_THE_ROUTER_OR_MEMORY
protected_invariants.rule: A one-message correction should be enough to create a durable scoped change attempt; the human must not copy context between chats, select worker IDs, or explain recovered state again. If software cannot complete, surface the real typed boundary instead of silently doing nothing.
protected_invariants.why: The operating target is disposable workers plus durable coordination, not manual courier/scheduler behavior.

regression_matrix.failure: A worker sees a live José/Student World page and makes it the Alumnos root or edits PROJECT_INDEX as if discovery already bound it.
regression_matrix.falsification_test: Starting from the current unbound PROJECT_INDEX, request a local child-page change. PASS only if the worker targets the actual child owner and leaves root binding unchanged unless a separately-authorized binding operation is active.

regression_matrix.failure: Student World/José/class/atlas/homework/PageKit are rendered or persisted as one generic page tree, losing exact reopen/owner semantics.
regression_matrix.falsification_test: Open/reopen each known identity through durable refs before and after a candidate integration. PASS only if each identity remains separately addressable and no owner pointer is silently replaced.

regression_matrix.failure: A student/root page copies or locally rewrites Study UI primitives instead of consuming shared/study owner code.
regression_matrix.falsification_test: Diff candidate files and dependency refs. FAIL if new duplicated shared Study CSS/JS or a second current-owner pointer appears; breaking behavior must name a v2 migration path.

regression_matrix.failure: A redesign flattens four Algebra topics into one rail, changes the 12-level-per-topic structure, or substitutes the 48 canonical exercise identities without explicit scope.
regression_matrix.falsification_test: Count topic identities, per-topic level identities and canonical exercise bindings in the candidate. PASS only at 4 distinct topics, 12 local levels each and the preserved canonical exercise source unless the human delta explicitly changes one of these invariants.

regression_matrix.failure: Scrolling/changing theory resets, advances or mutates the active practice attempt/answer/board unexpectedly.
regression_matrix.falsification_test: Enter an exercise, create answer/board state, scroll/switch theory within the same concept, then return. PASS only if practice identity and user state remain intact unless an explicit navigation action changes them.

regression_matrix.failure: A candidate works with one pointer path but loses wheel/trackpad, mouse grab, pen/touch drag, nested overflow or forces routine MCQ comparison off-screen.
regression_matrix.falsification_test: Run the same study journey on a small phone viewport plus desktop mouse/wheel. Verify actual scroll geometry, all four normal MCQ options simultaneously when intended, and that canvas drag draws while page/panel gestures retain their distinct roles.

regression_matrix.failure: A worker replaces the V26 stability baseline with V37 wholesale because V37 has better laser/object behavior or a larger version number.
regression_matrix.falsification_test: For every adopted PageKit delta, produce a capability-level map. FAIL if unrelated UX changes arrive without explicit acceptance evidence or if V26 ceases to be available as rollback donor without an authorized replacement.

regression_matrix.failure: Hover starts erasing, object/erase actions become irreversible, or board-session tabs and sheet tabs are normalized into the wrong model.
regression_matrix.falsification_test: Pointer-hover over ink with eraser selected must not mutate ink; erase/object actions adopted from V37 must undo/replay correctly; tab model must match the target surface's declared semantics.

regression_matrix.failure: UI/product copy or return evidence claims Wacom pressure/buttons or application Fullscreen although only generic pointer/viewport behavior is present.
regression_matrix.falsification_test: Require direct implementation + runtime evidence for pressure/buttons and requestFullscreen/fullscreenchange before any such claim. Otherwise result must remain NOT_EVIDENCED.

regression_matrix.failure: A successful worker returns a raw page link/commit but the human loses the Prometeo host, change thread, unread state or exact continuation context.
regression_matrix.falsification_test: Submit one page-scoped correction from the host. PASS only if the resulting durable RETURN appears through the page change feed and the preview/result can be opened while retaining the host/change-thread context.

regression_matrix.failure: Two workers edit overlapping page/shared paths and the later commit silently writes against stale state or erases the other's useful delta.
regression_matrix.falsification_test: Run two deliberate overlapping edit attempts. PASS only if exclusive/owner scopes detect the collision and the second worker reconciles/narrows/stops rather than blind-overwriting; late candidate evidence remains recoverable.

regression_matrix.failure: A correction cannot proceed unless the human supplies an old chat, routes a worker, repeats already-durable context or interprets internal repository state.
regression_matrix.falsification_test: In a fresh chat with only the stable Prometeo entry and one natural-language Alumnos correction, PASS if the system resolves project/child/context from durable state, claims work and either returns a visible result or a precise non-recoverable boundary without asking for recoverable context.

minimum_preintegration_gate: Resolve the actual child/root target; do not treat alumnos-teacher label as page authority.
Load current owner + EPOCH and re-fetch exact changed bytes before material mutation.
Build a preserve map for every baseline capability touched; candidate fails on unrequested loss.
Run the relevant falsification tests above, including small-phone and pointer-path tests for UI changes.
Keep candidate/tested/human-accepted/current/served states distinct and attach exact evidence refs.
Return result through the durable Page Change/host path when that path is operational; do not call a raw child URL the completed human flow.
non_obvious_findings: The highest-risk Alumnos regression is currently identity/authority collapse, not visual breakage: the coordination surface does not yet map one-to-one to a physical page.
A visually successful root composition can still be a hard regression if it creates a second Study owner or promotes a child frontier into root authority by inference.

V37 should be treated as a capability donor, not a successor page: adopting its best interaction features without a capability map can silently lose the V26 rollback contract or import incompatible board semantics.

The one-message human-correction goal introduces a system-level UX test: success is not merely a changed HTML file, but a durable result that returns to the Prometeo host without making the human carry context.

dedup.reason: Root binding, Alumnos truth/intent/UX/reuse/discovery/planning and dependency-gated local integration already exist in prepared or active work. This ledger is an input/guardrail for those lanes rather than a duplicate task generator.
